app.title: openframe
lang.label: Interface language
nav.label: Sections
error.unauthorized: Not paired, or the pairing was revoked.
error.forbidden_origin: The request came from another website.
error.unsupported_media_type: This type of file is not accepted.
error.unsupported_format: This image format is not supported.
error.insufficient_storage: Not enough storage on the frame.
error.image_too_large: The image is too large: more than 100 megapixels or longer than 32:1.
error.storage_unavailable: The photo storage of the frame is not available right now. Try again later.
error.decoder_unavailable: The frame cannot check images right now. Try again in a minute.
error.safe_mode: The frame is in safe mode after repeated crashes; photos rest until it starts normally.
error.not_in_safe_mode: The frame is not in safe mode any more.
safe.title: Safe mode
safe.text: The frame stopped showing photos after repeated crashes. Settings, devices and the log still work. Start it normally to try the photos again.
safe.restarting: The frame restarts in normal mode …
error.delete_failed: The file could not be deleted.
error.move_failed: The file could not be saved.
error.render_failed: The photo could not be prepared.
error.internal_error: The frame reported an internal error.
pair.title: Pair with the frame
pair.hint: Scan the QR code on the frame with your phone's camera, or enter the six-digit code below it. If the frame shows neither, tap the display or choose “Show code on frame” below.
pair.codeShown: The frame now shows a code for 5 minutes.
pair.expired: The code has expired. Show a new one on the frame.
pair.locked: Too many attempts. Please wait {seconds} seconds.
pair.linkExpired: The pairing link has expired. Scan the QR code on the frame again.
pair.linkInvalid: The pairing link is no longer valid. Scan the QR code on the frame again.
photos.empty: No photos yet. Upload some or copy them to the frame's photo folder over USB.
photos.quarantinedLabel: {name}: not shown, it made the image decoder crash
photos.quarantinedText: This photo made the frame's image decoder crash, so the frame does not show it. Try it again, or hide or delete it.
photos.confirmDeleteOne: Delete this photo permanently? The file is removed from the frame as well.
photos.commentHint: The frame shows it over the photo.
section.label: Section
section.title: Choose section
section.hint: Drag the photo to move it. Zoom with two fingers, the mouse wheel or the buttons. The frame shows exactly this part from the next photo change on.
section.viewport: Section as the frame shows it
skipped.hint: The frame could not add {n} files from its photo folder.
skipped.too_large: too large (more than 100 megapixels or longer than 32:1)
skipped.crashed: made the image decoder crash; it is checked again when the file changes
upload.title: Upload photos
upload.drop: Drop files here or choose them
upload.tooLarge: Too large: more than 100 megapixels or longer than 32:1
upload.storage: Not enough storage on the frame
albums.empty: No albums yet. An album is a folder in the photo folder, its subfolders are sub-albums.
settings.section.caption: Caption
settings.name: Frame name
settings.transitionFallback: This frame’s display cannot show the transition smoothly, so photos change instantly. Change the transition or its duration to try it again.
settings.fillMode.auto: Automatic (crop at most a quarter, borders for the rest)
settings.captionHint: The frame always shows a photo's comment over it.
settings.placeChanges: converted, positions rounded, one German name chosen per place
settings.cacheBudgetHint: 100 to 10,000 MB. Original photos do not count.
settings.localOnlyHint: “Local only” mode is switched on the frame itself: press and hold a corner.
devices.title: Paired devices
devices.confirmRemove: Unpair “{name}”? The device will have to pair again.
devices.confirmRemoveSelf: Unpair this device? You will have to pair again with a new code.
devices.inviteHint: Scan the code with the camera of the other device, or open the link there. It pairs one device, once.
skipped.hintOne: The frame could not add 1 file from its photo folder.
photos.confirmDeleteMany: Delete {n} photos permanently? The files are removed from the frame as well.
sources.intro: Show photos from other places on this frame: the link of a shared Nextcloud folder or a Nextcloud account. The frame only reads them, nothing is changed there.
sources.linkHint: The link Nextcloud shows for a shared folder, for example https://cloud.example.org/s/AbC123
sources.passwordHint: Only if the share has one. It stays on the frame and is never shown again.
sources.full: The frame has 8 sources, the most it can hold. Remove one to add another. An account that is already a source can log in again here to renew its access.
sources.serverInvalid: An address that starts with http:// or https://
sources.httpWarning: This address uses http: the access is sent without encryption.
sources.waiting: Waiting for your approval in the Nextcloud tab …
sources.loginExpired: The login expired. Please try again.
sources.name: Name
sources.folderHint: The photos below this folder are shown. If you change it, the hidden states of the photos of the old folder are lost.
sources.noFolder: Choose the folder whose photos should be shown, then save. Until then nothing is synced.
sources.includeSubfolders: Include subfolders (each folder is an album)
sources.removeVanished: Remove photos that are deleted on the server
sources.budgetHint: If it is exceeded, the originals of this source unused for the longest time are removed and fetched again when needed.
sources.confirmRemove: Remove “{name}”? Its photos are removed from this frame; local photos and the other sources stay.
photos.noDeleteRemote: Photos of a source cannot be deleted here. Hide them instead.
error.read_only_source: This photo comes from a source and cannot be deleted here. Hide it instead.
error.invalid_album: The album path is too long: at most 255 characters.
error.nextcloud_unreachable: The frame cannot reach the Nextcloud server, or does not trust its certificate.
error.too_many_sources: The frame has 8 sources already. Remove one first.
error.source_exists: This share is a source already.
error.share_not_found: There is no share at this link. It may have been withdrawn.
error.share_not_a_folder: This link shares a single file. Share a folder instead.
error.share_password_required: This share is protected. Enter its password.
error.share_not_readable: This link only accepts uploads (a file drop). The frame can only read shares; share the folder with “view only” or “allow upload and editing”.
sources.waitingForOther: Waiting for the sync of another source …
settings.displaySchedule: Switch the display off at night
settings.displayTimesHint: An off time before the on time ends on the next day. The same time for both keeps the display on all day.
settings.wakeMinutesHint: The power button wakes the frame at night. It goes off again this long after the last touch.
display.notAvailable: The frame may not switch its display off yet. Allow it once on the frame: press a corner for three seconds and choose “Display schedule: not allowed”.
settings.brightnessHint: With Android's setting the frame keeps the brightness set on the device. A change on the device holds until the frame next sets its own brightness.
settings.dimHint: Without a dim time the display is not dimmed. From the dim time until the display goes off, and while it is woken at night, the frame uses the dimmed brightness.
brightness.notAvailable: The frame may not change its brightness yet. Allow it once on the frame: press a corner for three seconds and choose “Brightness control: not allowed”.
error.display_unavailable: The frame may not switch its display off. Allow it in the device menu on the frame.
error.brightness_unavailable: The frame may not change its brightness. Allow it in the device menu on the frame.
error.display_off: The display is off. The photo changes only when it is on again.
settings.autoUpdateCheckHint: Every 6 hours the frame asks GitHub (api.github.com) for the latest release of openframe. GitHub sees the frame's public IP address. Local-only mode does not stop this.
update.phase.installing: The installation dialog is open on the frame: confirm it there.
update.phase.unsupported: Updates exist only for official builds of openframe. This frame runs a build of its own.
update.installHint: The installation has to be confirmed on the frame.
update.requested: The installation dialog is now open on the frame. Confirm it there.
update.notAllowed: The frame does not allow installing apps: allow apps from unknown sources in the frame's system settings.
update.restarting: The frame is restarting with the new version …
update.error.update_rate_limited: GitHub limits the requests for now; the frame tries again later.
update.error.update_not_found: GitHub has no release of openframe.
update.error.update_no_apk: The latest release has no APK of openframe.
update.error.update_no_checksum: The latest release states no checksum for its APK.
update.error.update_checksum: The download did not match the checksum of the release.
update.error.update_invalid_apk: The APK of the release is not a valid update for this frame.
update.error.update_signature: The APK of the release is signed with another key than the installed app.
update.error.update_storage: Not enough free storage on the frame for the update.
update.error.update_tls: The certificate of GitHub's server is not trusted.
update.error.install_cancelled: The installation was cancelled on the frame.
update.error.install_unanswered: Nobody confirmed the installation on the frame within 10 minutes.
update.error.install_failed: Android could not install the update.
error.update_not_ready: No update is ready to install.
error.install_not_allowed: The frame does not allow installing apps from unknown sources.
error.install_in_progress: The installation dialog is already open on the frame.
error.install_cooldown: The dialog was declined a moment ago. Try again later, or install from the menu on the frame.
reload.text: The frame was updated to version {version}.
